title: Case 032: Toilet flush mechanism repair
initial_request:
Issue with toilet flusher in second bedroom.
Assuming this is straightforward and cheap enough but please quote if it's a big job! Thank you
overview: The tenant reported a problem with the toilet flusher in the second bedroom. The landlord approved sending a contractor and later approved a £165 + VAT quote for a new flusher. The provider and tenant arranged a visit, with a call one hour before arrival requested. The provider subsequently confirmed the repair was complete and the invoice had been uploaded; the request was marked completed.
outcome: The provider confirmed that the toilet flush mechanism repair was complete and that the invoice had been uploaded.
